title: Concept: Gem requirement with no upper bound
description: Gemfile declares a `>=` gem requirement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` gem requirement.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` gem requirement.
